concept: PAM3 Modulation and GDDR7 Channel Interleaving
summary: Source-anchored research for PAM3 Modulation and GDDR7 Channel Interleaving. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: PAM3 signaling achieves a 50% data rate improvement over binary NRZ at identical Nyquist frequencies by encoding three voltage levels into two transmitted unit intervals. (high confidence)

GDDR7 splits each physical device channel into dual independent 16-bit sub-channels, enabling concurrent burst accesses that avoid bank collision stalls during attention matrix reads. (high confidence)
